programme.title: #IkLome / #LIKEME
programme.desc: The tension can be cut because after the many rehearsal, the time has finally come: premiere evening. Vince's parents bring some extra drama to school. Other parents do not show up. Andere ouders komen dan weer niet opdagen. En de bewogen avond eindigt noodlottig.

programme.title: De Board of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: Pupils and teachers change places one day a year. Fate decides that Pedro will be director for a day this year. Pedro leads the school with a hard hand. For example, the students have to pay to sit on a chair. Soekie leads the resistance to dictator Pedro. / Een dag per jaar wisselen leerlingen en leraars van plaats. Het lot beslist dat Pedro dit jaar directeur wordt voor een dag. Pedro leidt de school met harde hand. Zo moeten de leerlingen betalen om op een stoel te zitten. Soekie leidt het verzet tegen dictator Pedro.

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: A student exchange project is done at school. The niece of Olivia, Annabelle, is assigned to the Hoppers and comes to stay with them for a few days. The hoppers are enthusiastic, but then it appears that Annabelle is a very bizarre girl. For example, she has a stuffed crow and she plays nasty violin in the middle of the night. The hoppers are becoming increasingly scared of Annabelle and do not know what to do with their strange guest. / Op school wordt een studentenuitwisselingsproject gedaan. Het nichtje van Olivia, Annabelle, wordt toegewezen aan de Hoppers en komt een paar dagen bij hen logeren. De Hoppers zijn enthousiast, maar dan blijkt dat Annabelle wel een heel bizar meisje is. Zo heeft ze een opgezette kraai mee en speelt ze akelig viool in het midden van de nacht. De Hoppers worden steeds banger van Annabelle en weten niet wat ze met hun vreemde gast moeten aanvangen.

programme.title: Flanders Holiday Country / Vlaanderen vakantieland
programme.desc: Maureen Vanherberghen and radio maker Sofie Lemaire go on weekends in the Maasland. Maureen and Sofie sail from Limburg SailCenter in Ophoven-Kessenich de Maas on a Treibgut-Vlot. Along the way they moor to visit the white town of Thorn, just across the border with the Netherlands. There they are met by Stadsgids Annelies Frenken, who takes them on the theme walk The Mighty Women of Thorn. In the evening, Maureen and Sofie throw out their anchor in a quiet spot on the Maasplassen, for a snack and a drink and an invigorating night's sleep. The second day are Maureen and Sofie in Maaseik, where Stadsgids Lieve Weerjens introduces them to the story of the Bokkenrijders, who were very active in the region in the eighteenth century. Then a trip waits in a Fiat 500 that takes them to places that were important for the goat riders. / Maureen Vanherberghen en radiomaker Sofie Lemaire gaan op weekend in het Maasland. Maureen en Sofie varen vanuit Limburg Sailcenter in Ophoven-Kessenich de Maas af op een Treibgut-vlot. Onderweg meren ze aan om een bezoek te brengen aan het witte stadje Thorn, net over de grens met Nederland. Daar worden ze opgewacht door stadsgids Annelies Frenken, die hen meeneemt op de themawandeling De machtige vrouwen van Thorn. s Avonds gooien Maureen en Sofie hun anker uit op een rustig plekje op de Maasplassen, voor een hapje en een drankje en een verkwikkende nachtrust. De tweede dag zijn Maureen en Sofie in Maaseik, waar stadsgids Lieve Weetjens hen introduceert in het verhaal van de bokkenrijders, die in de achttiende eeuw heel actief waren in de streek. Daarna wacht hen een tochtje in een Fiat 500 die hen langs plekken brengt die belangrijk waren voor de bokkenrijders.

programme.desc: The newly compiled family of Tine and Marijke lives in Heist-op-den-Berg. Marijke had two children from her previous marriage, Tine Five. programme.desc: All the gymnastics material is broken. Soekie promises that she will provide a new trampoline. But then she discovers that the money was not completely acquired in an honest way. If Pedro discovers this, he will immediately demand her resignation. / Al het turnmateriaal is stuk. programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a TV story format whose themes are BH. Cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of valuable cultural treasure that preserve museums across the country. The best promotion of the state is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots keep thousands of valuable cases and exhibits, including numerous world rarities. Collections and collections do not even lag behind the settings in reputable European and world museums. This form of BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories are processed only by basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit museums and institutions in which exhibits are found. In the fundus you will see the interesting facts you haven't known so far, the items you haven't seen before, and it will also present part of the tradition on which there is no information recorded. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

Međutim, zgodni i šarmantni prodavač farmaceutskih proizvoda zaljubi se u vrckavu Maggie. To dvoje ljudi koji nisu vjerovali u ljubav otkriju kako je upravo njihova međusobna privlačnost najjača droga na tržištu. Uloge: Jake Gyllenhaal, Anne Hathaway, Judy Greer, Hank Azaria Režija: Edward Zwick

programme.desc: The mysteries of Dr. Blake (The Doctor: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) is an Australian television series first aired on ABC on February 1, 2013 at 8:30 pm [1]. Creg Dugal McLlan is in the role of Dr. Lucien Blake, who returned to Balarat, northwest of Melbourne, in the late 1950s, to take over the general medical practice of his late father and the role of a police surgeon after 30 years. Five seasons have been broadcast until 2017, after which the program is closed at the end of the fifth season. The first two seasons have 10 episodes while the next ones have 8 each. Each episode is about an hour - between 56 and 59 minutes. / Мистериите на доктор Блейк (на английски: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) е австралийски телевизионен сериал, излъчен за първи път по ABC на 1 февруари 2013 г. в 20:30 часа[1]. Крег Дугъл Маклалън е в ролята на доктор Лусиен Блейк, който се завръща в Баларат, северозападно от Мелбърн, в края на 1950-те години, за да поеме общата медицинска практика на покойния си баща и ролята на полицейски хирург след отсъствие от 30 години. Пет сезона се излъчват до 2017 г., след което програмата е закрита в края на петия сезон. Първите два сезона имат 10 епизода докато следващите имат по 8. Всеки епизод е около час – между 56 и 59 минути.

programme.desc: National teams from different continents compete in groups and playoffs to win a place among the best to fight for the world title. The qualifications are divided into Confederations - Europe (UEFA), South America (CONMEBOL), Asia (AFC), Africa (Kaf), North and Central America (Konkacaf) and Oceania (OFK). Each region has its own format, with matches being held for several years. / Националните отбори от различни континенти се състезават в групи и плейофи, за да спечелят място сред най-добрите, които ще се борят за световната титла. Квалификациите са разделени по конфедерации – Европа (УЕФА), Южна Америка (КОНМЕБОЛ), Азия (АФК), Африка (КАФ), Северна и Централна Америка (КОНКАКАФ) и Океания (ОФК). Всеки регион има свой формат, като мачовете се провеждат в продължение на няколко години.

programme.title: Cultural heritage / Kulturna baština
programme.desc: Cultural Heritage - (Doc. Series, Croatia, 2013) in medieval cities with surrounded walls where the space was valuable and carefully planned, there were usually no parks or larger green spaces. Only when the ramparts and towers became superfluous and when the circumstances allowed it could they begin to conquer new areas outside the historic center. Thus, at the end of the 19th century, the Sibenik "Djardin" was created, a park that today bears the name of Robert Visiani, a botanist born here in 1800. If the beauty is the promise of happiness, the people of Sibenik really could be happy in their little oasis of greenery arranged by Italian public parks. R.: Luka Marotti ... / Kulturna baština - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2013) U srednjovjekovnim gradovima opasanim zidinama gdje je prostor bio dragocjen i pomno isplaniran obično nije bilo perivoja ni većih zelenih površina. Tek kada su bedemi i kule postali suvišni i kada su okolnosti to dopustile, mogle su se početi osvajati nove površine izvan povijesne jezgre. Tako je potkraj 19. stoljeća nastao i šibenski "đardin", perivoj koji danas nosi ime Roberta Visianija, botaničara rođenog ovdje 1800. godine. Ako je ljepota obećanje sreće, Šibenčani su doista mogli biti sretni u svojoj maloj oazi zelenila uređenoj po uzoru na talijanske javne parkove. R.: Luka Marotti...

programme.title: Gardener / Vrtlarica
programme.desc: Gardener - (S04, E11, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2023) For all those who feel nature as part of their lives, for those who enjoy the beauty of green plants and flowers, for those who have introduced gardening into their everyday life, there is a showcase. Starting from the position of nature protection and its own health, the author of Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, in addition to the already well -known stories of organic growing vegetables, fruits and flowers, also explores new areas related to horticulture and the green plant world. It reveals breeders that are plants and passion and life, beautifully shaped gardens, but also ways in which plants we can prepare, process and use in everyday life. The base and origin of these studies is the author's garden located on the Zagorje side of the hillside of Medvednica. He is a place of permanent experts with plants, but also a meeting place with interesting guests who transmit their own experiences about breeding or using plants. However, the author goes on, traveling around Croatia and meets interesting places and people who have tied their lives to the cultivation of some unusual species. For all those who want to really relax and enjoy the content that will provide inspiration and many useful ideas, Sunday afternoon will be reserved for the gardener from now on. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (S04, E11, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Za sve one koji prirodu osjećaju kao dio svog života, za one koji uživaju u ljepoti zelenih biljaka i cvijeća, za one koji su vrtlarstvo uveli u svoju svakodnevicu, tu je emisija Vrtlarica. Polazeći s pozicije zaštite prirode i vlastitog zdravlja, autorica Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, uz već poznate priče o organskom uzgoju povrća, voća i cvijeća, istražuje i nova područja vezana uz hortikulturu i zeleni biljni svijet. Otkriva uzgajivače kojima su biljke i strast i život, predivno oblikovane vrtove, ali i načine na koje biljke možemo pripremiti, preraditi i koristiti u svakodnevnom životu. Baza i ishodište tih istraživanja je autoričin vrt smješten na zagorskoj strani obronaka Medvednice. On je mjesto stalnih eksperimanata s biljakama, ali i mjesto susreta sa zanimljivim gostima koji prenose vlastita iskustva o uzgoju ili korištenju biljaka. No, autorica polazi i dalje, putuje po Hrvatskoj i upoznaje zanimljiva mjesta i ljude koji su svoj život vezali uz uzgoj neke neobične vrste. Za sve one koji se žele doista opustiti i uživati u sadržaju koji će pružiti inspiraciju i mnoštvo korisnih ideja, nedjelja poslijepodne bit će od sada rezervirana za Vrtlaricu. R.: Nino Šoštarić...

programme.desc: The Waterworld of Komodo - (E04, Nature. Film, Poland, 2021) This documentary series takes us on an extraordinary trip to one of the most beautiful places on Earth. During the millions of years, the archipelago around the Island of Komoda was formed by the forces of nature and the mechanisms of evolution. Thanks to its isolation, today we can admire the works of nature that do not exist anywhere else on the planet. On land are undisputed rulers of legendary dragons, while under the water of a strong current flows around coral reefs that abound in life. The underwater world is ruled by sharks and magnificent mants. Each of the five episodes shows both worlds as well as the laws that governed them. The series allows us to get to know the unique ecosystem and discover the region whose world was periodically destroyed by devastating volcanoes. The series is also an exceptional journey that rethinks the role of man on earth. Each episode has a major topic. Commodern Varani, manta or sharks are shown in their natural environment. However, the authors are not only focused on the hero of the episodes, but also of the conditions in which he lives and other inhabitants in his ecosystem. The series also depicts people living in its ecosystem as well as the mutual influence of man and nature. R .: Andrzej MisiUk ... / The Waterworld of Komodo - (E04, prirod. film, Poljska, 2021) Ova dokumentarna serija vodi nas na iznimno putovanje na jedno od najljepših mjesta na Zemlji. Tijekom milijuna godina arhipelag oko otoka Komoda oblikovale su sile prirode i mehanizmi evolucije. Zahvaljujući njegovoj izoliranosti, i danas se možemo diviti djelima prirode kakva ne postoje nigdje drugdje na planetu. Na kopnu su neprikosnoveni vladari legendarni zmajevi, dok ispod vode snažne struje teku oko koraljnih grebena koji obiluju životom. Podvodnim svijetom vladaju morski psi i veličanstvene mante. Svaka od pet epizoda prikazuje oba svijeta kao i zakone koji njima upravljaju. Serija nam omogućuje da upoznamo jedinstveni ekosustav i otkrijemo regiju čiji su svijet periodički uništavali razorni vulkani. Serija je i iznimno putovanje koje preispituje ulogu čovjeka na Zemlji. Svaka epizoda ima glavnu temu. Komodski varani, mante ili morski psi prikazani su u svom prirodnom okružju. Ipak, autori se ne usredotočuju samo na junaka epizode, nego i na uvjete u kojima živi te na druge stanovnike u njegovu ekosustavu. Serija prikazuje i ljude koji žive u njegovu ekosustavu kao i međusobni utjecaj čovjeka i prirode. R.: Andrzej Misiuk...

programme.title: Cultural heritage / Kulturna baština
programme.desc: Cultural Heritage - (Doc. Series, Croatia) from Trsat provides one of the most suspicious visors of Rijeka, from where the stairs starting at the chapel of the Mother of God of the Shadow of Sorrowful heading towards Trsat. In 1531, the oldest and most famous Rijeka stairs were built in 1531 by Petar Kružić, royal captain Senj and Klis, known for the fight against the Turks. Along the stairs, at first, there were only a hundred, and today there are as many as five hundred sixty -one, porches and chapels for prayer, as well as the holidays of pilgrims and residents of this part of the city. R.: Luka Marotti ... / Kulturna baština - (dok. serija, Hrvatska) Iz Trsata se pruža jedna od najsugestivnijih vizura Rijeke odakle se stubama počevši kod kapelice Majke Božje Tješiteljice Žalosnih kreće prema Trsatu. Najstarije i najpoznatije riječke stube dao je 1531. kao zavjet sagraditi Petar Kružić, kraljevski kapetan Senja i Klisa, poznat po borbama protiv Turaka. Duž stuba, kojih je u početku bilo samo stotinjak, a danas ih je čak petsto šezdeset jedna, nanizani su trijemovi i kapelice za molitvu, ali i odmor hodočasnika i stanovnika ovog dijela grada. R.: Luka Marotti...

programme.title: Gardener / Vrtlarica
programme.desc: Gardener - (S04, E12, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2023) For all those who feel nature as part of their lives, for those who enjoy the beauty of green plants and flowers, for those who have introduced gardening into their daily lives, there is a garden. Starting from the position of nature protection and its own health, the author of Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, in addition to the already well -known stories of organic growing vegetables, fruits and flowers, also explores new areas related to horticulture and the green plant world. It reveals breeders that are plants and passion and life, beautifully shaped gardens, but also ways in which plants we can prepare, process and use in everyday life. The base and origin of these studies is the author's garden located on the Zagorje side of the hillside of Medvednica. He is a place of permanent experts with plants, but also a meeting place with interesting guests who transmit their own experiences about breeding or using plants. However, the author goes on, traveling around Croatia and meets interesting places and people who have tied their lives to the cultivation of some unusual species. For all those who want to really relax and enjoy the content that will provide inspiration and many useful ideas, Sunday afternoon will be reserved for the gardener from now on. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (S04, E12, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Za sve one koji prirodu osjećaju kao dio svog života, za one koji uživaju u ljepoti zelenih biljaka i cvijeća, za one koji su vrtlarstvo uveli u svoju svakodnevicu, tu je emisija Vrtlarica. Polazeći s pozicije zaštite prirode i vlastitog zdravlja, autorica Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, uz već poznate priče o organskom uzgoju povrća, voća i cvijeća, istražuje i nova područja vezana uz hortikulturu i zeleni biljni svijet. Otkriva uzgajivače kojima su biljke i strast i život, predivno oblikovane vrtove, ali i načine na koje biljke možemo pripremiti, preraditi i koristiti u svakodnevnom životu. Baza i ishodište tih istraživanja je autoričin vrt smješten na zagorskoj strani obronaka Medvednice. On je mjesto stalnih eksperimanata s biljakama, ali i mjesto susreta sa zanimljivim gostima koji prenose vlastita iskustva o uzgoju ili korištenju biljaka. No, autorica polazi i dalje, putuje po Hrvatskoj i upoznaje zanimljiva mjesta i ljude koji su svoj život vezali uz uzgoj neke neobične vrste. Za sve one koji se žele doista opustiti i uživati u sadržaju koji će pružiti inspiraciju i mnoštvo korisnih ideja, nedjelja poslijepodne bit će od sada rezervirana za Vrtlaricu. R.: Nino Šoštarić...

programme.title: Cocoa / Cacau
programme.desc: Cacao - (S01, E136, feature series, Portugal, 2024) Telenovela talks about the life of a beautiful, brave and unbridled 22 -year -old girl Cacau who lives on a property with her parents Portuguese, Joaquim and Filomena. They are hosts and people of the trust of the rich boss of Justin, a vase of Pereire, also a Portuguese, who is old and ill, and follows the business from Portugal. The best friends of Cacau are Pitty and Guto who help her make the idea that Brazil tasted the best chocolate - spicy chocolate from Itacare. Cacau works at the chocolate factory, and spends his free time in the warm sea of ​​Bahia where he loves surf. She is gifted with chocolate manufacturer, and her biggest dream is to get an international degree in confectionery and chocolate skills. However, she believes that this is unattainable because her family does not need money for that very expensive course. R.: Ricardo Carreira Ul.: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala) ... / Cacao - (S01, E136, igrana serija, Portugal, 2024) Telenovela govori o životu lijepe, hrabre i neobuzdane 22-godišnje djevojke Cacau koja živi na imanju na kojemu su njezini roditelji Portugalci, Joaquim i Filomena. Oni su domaćini i ljudi od povjerenja bogatoga gazde Justina Vaza Pereire, također Portugalca, koji je star i bolestan, pa prati poslovanje iz Portugala. Najbolji prijatelji Cacau su Pitty i Guto koji joj pomažu ostvariti zamisao da Brazil kuša najbolju čokoladu - pikantnu čokoladu iz Itacarea. Cacau radi u tvornici čokolade, a slobodno vrijeme provodi u toplom moru Bahije gdje voli surfati. Nadarena je proizvođačica čokolade, a najveći joj je san dobiti međunarodnu diplomu iz slastičarstva i čokoladnih vještina. Ipak vjeruje da joj je to nedostižno jer njezina obitelj nema potreban novac za taj vrlo skup tečaj. programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E22, feature series, Spain) in 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of La Provece owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. programme.title: The water world of the dresser / Vodeni svijet Komoda
programme.desc: The Waterworld of Komodo - (E04, Nature. Film, Poland, 2021) This documentary series takes us on an extraordinary trip to one of the most beautiful places on Earth. During the millions of years, the archipelago around the Island of Komoda was formed by the forces of nature and the mechanisms of evolution. Thanks to its isolation, today we can admire the works of nature that do not exist anywhere else on the planet. On land are undisputed rulers of legendary dragons, while under the water of a strong current flows around coral reefs that abound in life. The underwater world is ruled by sharks and magnificent mants. Each of the five episodes shows both worlds as well as the laws that governed them. The series allows us to get to know the unique ecosystem and discover the region whose world was periodically destroyed by devastating volcanoes. The series is also an exceptional journey that rethinks the role of man on earth. Each episode has a major topic. Commodern Varani, manta or sharks are shown in their natural environment. However, the authors are not only focused on the hero of the episodes, but also of the conditions in which he lives and other inhabitants in his ecosystem. The series also depicts people living in its ecosystem as well as the mutual influence of man and nature. Tijekom milijuna godina arhipelag oko otoka Komoda oblikovale su sile prirode i mehanizmi evolucije. Zahvaljujući njegovoj izoliranosti, i danas se možemo diviti djelima prirode kakva ne postoje nigdje drugdje na planetu. Na kopnu su neprikosnoveni vladari legendarni zmajevi, dok ispod vode snažne struje teku oko koraljnih grebena koji obiluju životom. Podvodnim svijetom vladaju morski psi i veličanstvene mante. Svaka epizoda ima glavnu temu. Komodski varani, mante ili morski psi prikazani su u svom prirodnom okružju. Ipak, autori se ne usredotočuju samo na junaka epizode, nego i na uvjete u kojima živi te na druge stanovnike u njegovu ekosustavu. Autumn comes to Oxford, and the body of two thousand years old discovered in the Bramford Meur wetland gives a new trace in the case of a missing Matthew Laxman. Almost five years after Laxman has disappeared, Morse and Thursday have continued the investigation. The case is particularly affected by Thursday who thinks the county police messed up five years ago. The investigation leads them to a nuclear power plant where they come across a wall of silence that goes beyond secrecy and national interest. And one night someone broke into Endeavour's apartment and robbed him. Morse is still under the impression of this when he gets a job offer in London and the opportunity to start a fresh start. programme.title: Sokol's eyes / Oči sokolove
programme.desc: Falcon's eyes - (E08, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) The ancient Romans called him an imperial island, and legend says he was visited by the Mediterranean on his travels. Lastovo. This mysterious islands of incomprehensible beauty and the most beautiful sky in this part of Europe is a hidden pearl of the Adriatic Sea. Our trip to this mysterious archipelago begins on the islet of Glavat. The shots from the air meet the Croatian remote swimmer Dina Levacic, who swim around Glavat and the remaining 103 Croatian islands, islets and cliffs wants to raise the environmental awareness of citizens about the importance of maintaining the Adriatic Sea clean. The episode also brings stunning shots from the air of the Lastovo Islands Nature Park. Alexandra Carol Horvat, the main guardian of the Lastovo Islands PP, will be introduced to the peculiarities of the flora and fauna of this southern pearl. In the heart of the settlement, the famous drone will also feature the famous Lastovo carnage. Many masks, dance, song and fireworks have marked this event so important in the life of each resident of this island. The fisherman Ante also testifies that life on the island can be cruel and demanding. We followed him during the morning fish in the village of Zaklopatica. In the south of the Lastovo archipelago, we also visited the beacon Mladen on the Lighthouse of Struga, and the episode also brings stunning beauty of the islands during the famous Lastovo Trail race. At the end of our trip, we return to the village of Lastovo where we will see the production of the traditional Lastovo fumara. One of his last builders will be discussed about the famous chimneys and their construction. R.: Filip Filkovic ... / Oči sokolove - (E08, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) Stari Rimljani su ga nazivali carskim otokom, a legenda kaže kako ga je na svojim putovanjima Sredozemljem posjetio čak i Odisej. Lastovo. To tajanstveno otočje neshvatljive ljepote i najljepšeg neba u ovom dijelu Europe skriveni je biser Jadranskog mora. Naše putovanje ovim misterioznim arhipelagom počinje na otočiću Glavat. Snimke iz zraka ondje susreću hrvatsku daljinsku plivačicu Dinu Levačić koja plivajući oko Glavata i još preostala 103 hrvatska otoka, otočića i hridi želi podići ekološku svijest građana o važnosti održavanja Jadranskog mora čistim. Epizoda donosi i zadivljujuće snimke iz zraka Parka prirode Lastovsko otočje. S posebnostima flore i faune ovog južnog bisera upoznat će nas Alexandra Carol Horvat, glavna čuvarica PP Lastovsko otočje. U srcu naselja zadivljujuće snimke dronom prikazat će i poznati lastovski poklad. Mnoštvo maski, ples, pjesma i vatromet obilježili su ovaj događaj toliko važan u životu svakog stanovnika ovog otoka. Na samom jugu Lastovskog arhipelaga posjetili smo i svjetioničara Mladena na svjetioniku Struga, a epizoda donosi i zadivljujuće ljepote otočja tijekom održavanja poznate utrke Lastovo trail. programme.title: Rijeka stories / Riječke priče
programme.desc: Rijeka stories - (E03, travelogue series, Croatia, 2020) The third episode speaks of Rijeka from 19th to the First World War - about the Hungarian administration, the extension of the port, the construction of the railway and the expansion of the city, and the beginning of the inter -ethnic tension due to increased Hungarianization. There are also political circumstances, national conflicts and conflicts of different interests in the golden age of the economic flourishing of Rijeka from the mid -19th century to the First World War. The episode also brings the story of the short -term Dannunzi Rijeka adventure, from 1911 to 1921, its causes, the character of Dannunzi's protochasic administration in Rijeka, its defeat and consequences on the further political fate of the city on Rječina. Tu su i političke okolnosti, nacionalni sukobi te sukobi različitih interesa u zlatno doba ekonomskog procvata Rijeke od sredine 19. stoljeća do pred Prvi svjetski rat. Epizoda također donosi priču o kratkotrajnoj DAnnunzijevoj riječkoj avanturi, od 1911. do 1921. godine, njezinim uzrocima, karakteru DAnnunzijeve protofašističke uprave u Rijeci, njezinom porazu i posljedicama na daljnju političku sudbinu grada na Rječini. programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) Instead of intrusiveness and technical dismay, in the music of one of the most versatile jazz -gitarist Bill Frisella there are calmness, beauty of tone and above all - music. She is so expressed with him that his music is not particularly interested in genre frames, and so is jazz in the narrow sense, the essence is simply put in the beauty of playing and it has an advantage over every kind of manner or restrictions. However, this does not mean that it is a root -free musician: with jazz, there are above all expressed earthen, folk elements of American traditions that pursue a large trough we can call American. Given this tendency, it is not surprising that Frisell is largely a musician of paint, space and sound scene. However, the same is unmistakably recognized in wider formats, from the breakthroughs in the bands of drummer and musical relative Paul Motian, with whom he will collaborate for four decades, to a variety of compositions in which Frisell continues to gather masters of unobtrusiveness, such as Joey Baron or Kenny Wollesen. If Frisell's "natural" habitat should be determined, these would probably be small compositions - duo, trio - where everything rests on the most welcome focus, listening and interaction. Triapal format is perhaps a solid frame of his bandlider action, starting with the baron on drums and Kermit Driscoll on the double bass, which would often be upgraded to other associates. In recent years, the key Frisell's music comrades of drummer Rudy Royston and the fantastic counter -bassist Thomas Morgan, with which he recorded a couple of exceptional duo albums. He also came to Rijeka with them, where he performed as part of the 33rd edition of the Jazztime Rijeka Festival, reminding us how much one can say when equal attention is left with the space between notes and musicians, as well as notes themselves ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Umjesto nametljivosti i tehničkog razmetanja, u glazbi jednog od najsvestranijih jazz-gitarista Billa Frisella tu su mirnoća, ljepota tona i prije svega - muzikalnost. Toliko je ona kod njega izražena da njegova glazba nije posebno zainteresirana za žanrovske okvire, pa tako ni jazz u užem smislu, bit je u jednostavno rečeno ljepoti sviranja i ona ima prednost pred svakom vrstom manire ili ograničenja. To međutim ne znači da je riječ o muzičaru bez korijena: uz jazz, tu su prije svega izraženi zemljani, narodni elementi američke tradicije koji se slijevaju u veliko korito koje možemo nazvati americanom. S obzirom na tu sklonost, ne čudi da je Frisell u velikoj mjeri glazbenik boje, prostora i zvučnog prizora. No isto se nepogrešivo prepoznaje i u širim formatima, od proboja u bendovima bubnjara i glazbenog srodnika Paula Motiana, s kojim će surađivati tijekom četiri desetljeća, pa do najrazličitijih sastava u kojima Frisell nastavlja okupljati majstore nenametljivosti, kao što su Joey Baron ili Kenny Wollesen. Ako bi se trebalo odrediti Frisellovo "prirodno" stanište, to bi vjerojatno bili mali sastavi - duo, trio - gdje sve počiva na najpažljivijem fokusu, slušanju i interakciji. Format trija je možda i čvrst okvir njegova bendliderskog djelovanja počevši s onim s Baronom na bubnjevima i Kermitom Driscollom na kontrabasu, koji bi se često i nadograđivao drugim suradnicima. Zadnjih su godina ključni Frisellovi muzički drugovi bubnjar Rudy Royston i fantastični kontrabasist Thomas Morgan, s kojim je snimio i par iznimnih duo albuma. S njima je došao i u Rijeku, gdje je nastupio u sklopu 33. izdanja festivala JazzTime Rijeka podsjetivši nas koliko se toga može reći kada se jednaka pažnja ostavlja prostoru između nota i muzičara, kao i notama samima...

programme.desc: Out of format - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2023) in May 2024. Specifična interakcija društvenog angažmana i umjetnosti te prostor koji osim funkcije donosi i novu kvalitetu života njegovim korisnicima tema su emisije Izvan formata. programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2022) is our guest Lars Fr. H. Svendsen, a professor at the Institute of Philosophy of the University of Bergen. He has received several international awards and his books have been translated into 25 languages. His most famous books are "Philosophy of Boredom", "What is Philosophy?", "The Philosophy of Evil", "Fear" and "Philosophy of Loneliness" and the latest "Philosophy of Lies". After talking about freedom, evil and lies, it's time for mythology. And that of the city of Daruvar, into which film, television, theater and radio screenwriter, director and writer Dejan Sorak placed the shop of his new crime "Kupelj of God Silvan" ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2022) Naš je gost Lars Fr. H. Svendsen, profesor na Institutu za filozofiju Sveučilišta u Bergenu. Dobitnik je nekoliko međunarodnih nagrada, a knjige su mu prevedene na 25 jezika. Najpoznatije su mu knjige "Filozofija dosade", "Što je filozofija?", "Filozofija zla", "Strah" i "Filozofija usamljenosti" i najnovija "Filozofija laži". Nakon razgovora o slobodi, zlu i laži, vrijeme je za mitologiju. I to onu grada Daruvara u koji je filmski, televizijski, kazališni i radijski scenarist, redatelj i pisac Dejan Šorak smjestio radnju svog novog krimića "Kupelj boga Silvana"...

programme.title: My India / Moja Indija
programme.desc: My India - (E06, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2003) Madras, the capital of the Tamil Nada State, is located in the south of India. In history, there was a well -known port from which spices all over the world were driven. Today it is a modern city. Beautiful beaches, colonial history, the coupling of the new and old lives in the mattress. Most residents are fishing in a traditional way. After Mumbaja, Madras is the biggest movie city in India. The blue of the sky and the sea, the warm sand and the scent of Jasmine are characterized by this interesting city on the east side of the Bengal Bay. R .: Ljubica Jankovic Lazaric ... / Moja Indija - (E06, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2003) Madras, glavni grad države Tamil Nadu, smjestio se na jugu Indije. U povijesti je bio poznata luka iz koje su se odvozili začini po cijelom svijetu. Danas je moderan grad. Lijepe plaže, kolonijalna povijest, sprega novog i starog živi u Madrasu. Većina stanovnika bavi se ribolovom na tradicionalni način. Madras je nakon Mumbaja najveći filmski grad u Indiji. Plavetnilo neba i mora, topli pijesak i miris jasmina karakterizira ovaj zanimljiv grad na istočnoj strani Bengalskog zaljeva. R.: Ljubica Janković Lazarić...

programme.title: Wetlands and life in them / Močvarna staništa i život u njima
programme.desc: Wetlands of habitats and life in them - (E03, Doc. Film, Croatia, 2010) Wetland habitats belong to the most productive ecosystems in the world, along with rain forests and coral reefs. Kopački rit is one of the most important floods in Europe. The value of the Kopački rit Nature Park was confirmed in 1993 by its inclusion on the list of wet areas of international importance, especially as the habitats of the swamp birds, according to the Ramsar Convention, ie the Convention on Wet Areas. R .: Dominik Zen ... / Močvarna staništa i život u njima - (E03, dok. film, Hrvatska, 2010) Močvarna staništa pripadaju najproduktivnijim ekosustavima na svijetu, zajedno s kišnim šumama i koraljnim grebenima. Kopački rit je jedno od najvažnijih poplavnih područja u Europi. Vrijednost Parka prirode Kopački rit potvrđena je 1993. godine njegovim uvrštavanjem na popis vlažnih područja od međunarodne važnosti, osobito kao staništa ptica močvarica, prema Ramsarskoj konvenciji, odnosno Konvenciji o vlažnim područjima. R.: Dominik Zen...

programme.title: A collector of sounds / Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sound collector - (E06, feature series, Croatia) is a wonderful sunny day and a collector of sounds starts in search of a source of really interesting sound - scraping by cello! The following sound to the garden of a little girl, where she finds an incredible and slightly damaged cello lying on the back. What a great thing ... but what does it do? Decide to find out. It knocks it slightly - it sounds hollow and the wires vibrate. Then he pulled one wire strongly and recorded the sound ... The vibration is so strong to shake it. But he likes that feeling and continues to twist the wires gently, playing and recording a simple bass. At home, we discover the skills of Mirta's dance as he dances a waltz with a collector's tune of a cello that reaches the porch. In the garden, the collector of the sounds suddenly stops and hides when the girl returns. He starts playing the cello, but it sounds terrible. She will need a lot of exercises, but when she is ready, she will surely record her sounds. That evening he follows the recording of his bass dubs with ukulela - Mirta just can't stand still ... / Skupljač zvukova - (E06, igrana serija, Hrvatska) Predivan je sunčan dan i Skupljač zvukova kreće u potragu za izvorom zbilja zanimljivog zvuka - struganja po violončelu! Slijedi zvuk sve do vrta male djevojčice, gdje pronalazi nevjerojatno i pomalo oštećeno violončelo kako leži na poleđini. Kakva sjajna stvar... ali što ono radi? Odluči saznati. Lagano ga kucne - zvuči šuplje i žice vibriraju. Zatim snažno povuče jednu žicu i snimi zvuk... Vibracija je tako snažna da ga protrese. No sviđa mu se taj osjećaj i nastavlja nježnije trzati žice, svirajući i snimajući jednostavnu bas-dionicu. Kod kuće otkrivamo umijeće Mirtina plesa dok pleše valcer uz Skupljačevu melodiju violončela koja dopire do trijema. U vrtu, Skupljač zvukova iznenada stane i sakrije se kad se djevojčica vrati. Počne svirati violončelo, ali zvuči strašno. Trebat će joj puno vježbe, ali kad bude spremna, Skupljač zvukova sigurno će je snimiti. Te večeri prati snimku svoje bas-dionice uz ukulele - Mirta jednostavno ne može mirovati...

Every week from Monday to Thursday at 8.10pm, we bring you the best from the art world and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music ... / ART - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Art - vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu...

programme.title: Out of format / Izvan formata
programme.desc: Out of format - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2023) Sara Pukanic, Inia Herencic, Nika Mokos. There are three young women who write a new history of Croatian contemporary photographs with a camera in their hand. Their graduate exhibitions at the F8 Academy of Dramatic Arts Gallery in Zagreb showed that it is a mature author who, each in their own way, reflect on photography. Still, they have in common that their language is subtle, intimate and emotional. In the studio, we talk to the new generation of Croatian photographers, and their work is discussed by the head of the Chair of Photography Bojan Mrnjenović and the head of the F8 Gallery Jelena Blagović ... / Izvan formata - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2023) Sara Pukanić, Inia Herenčić, Nika Mokos. Tri su mlade žene koje s fotoaparatom u ruci pišu neku novu povijest hrvatske suvremene fotografije. Njihove diplomske izložbe u Galeriji f8 Akademije dramske umjetnosti u Zagrebu pokazale su da je riječ o zrelim autoricama koje, svaka na svoj način, promišljaju fotografiju. Ipak, zajedničko im je da je njihov jezik suptilan, intiman i emotivan. U studiju razgovaramo s novom generacijom hrvatskih fotografkinja, a o njihovom radu govore pročelnik Katedre za fotografiju Bojan Mrđenović i voditeljica galerije f8 Jelena Blagović...

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2022) We will start today's show by talking to Nada Gasic on the occasion of her book, the collection of stories "The Last they saw". Stories could be declared criminal, but when it comes to this author, her playful prose is best not to raise genre honey. The topic of conversation with the literary critic Dario Grgic is 14. Novel by Salman Rushdie, a author whose "children are midnight" the only novel that has won as many as two bookers. His works have been translated into more than 40 languages, he has received numerous world awards, because of his literary merit, he has been named a knight, a member of the American Academy of Arts and Literature and currently teaching as a guest at the University of New York. He is an honorary doctor and a member of six European and seven US universities. The novel "Quichotte", which we will present, translated Sasa Stancin from English ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2022) Današnju emisiju započet ćemo razgovorom s Nadom Gašić u povodu njezine knjige, zbirke priča "Posljednje što su vidjele". Priče bi se mogle proglasiti kriminalističkim, ali kada je ova autorica u pitanju, njezinoj zaigranoj prozi najbolje je ne podizati žanrovske međe. Tema razgovora s književnim kritičarom Dariom Grgićem je 14. roman Salmana Rushdieja, autora čija su "Djeca ponoći" jedini roman koji je osvojio čak dva Bookera. Djela su mu prevedena na više od 40 jezika, dobio je brojne svjetske nagrade, zbog svojih književnih zasluga proglašen je vitezom, član je Američke akademije umjetnosti i književnosti i trenutačno predaje kao gost na Sveučilištu u New Yorku. Počasni je doktor i član šest europskih i sedam američkih sveučilišta. Roman "Quichotte", koji ćemo predstaviti, s engleskog je preveo Saša Stančin...

programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: The world of classics - (music. Show, Croatia, 2024) in mid -June 2024. During the six performances at his home theater Grande Palais du Beaulie, Switzerland Lausanne, her status of intriguing choreography, which in a harmonious compound of classics and modernity, comments and answers to the important questions of today. Bejart Ballet is one of the world's most significant dance ensembles. She nurtures the spirit and oeuvre of the great French choreographer Maurice Bejart, who has absorbed Valentina Turco during the series of dancing years in his ensemble alone. In honor of Beyart's version of Hamlet, 40 years ago, she now, to the Bejart Ballet, gave her personal reading of the Shakespearene drama about the Danish Kraljevic. Thanks to the footage that organized the theater, we enjoy the part of that successful project ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Sredinom lipnja 2024. zagrebačka koreografkinja Valentina Turcu premijerno je uprizorila balet Hamlet s jednim od najvećih europskih baletnih ansambala, Bejart Balletom. Tijekom šest izvedbi u njegovu matičnome kazalištu Grande Palais du Beaulieu u švicarskoj Lausannei potvrđen je njezin status intrigantne koreografije koja u skladnom spoju klasike i suvremenosti daje komentare i odgovore na važna pitanja današnjice. Bejart Balet jedno je od najznačajnijih svjetskih plesnih ansambala. Njeguje duh i opus velikog francuskog koreografa Mauricea Bejarta koje je Valentina Turcu tijekom niza godina plesanja u njegovu ansamblu upijala i sama. U čast Bejartove inačice Hamleta otprije 40 godina sada je i ona, na narudžbu Bejart Baleta, dala svoje osobno čitanje shakespearijanske drame o danskom kraljeviću. Zahvaljujući snimci koje je organiziralo kazalište, i mi uživamo u dijelu tog uspješnog projekta...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) Famous avant -garde musician Elliott Sharp tells of his music that he contains both decorated and rational, both intuitive and irrational. That double nature of Sharp's huge curiosity was visible from an early age. During the study of Sharp's, the curiosity of the branches in the fields of music composition, ethnomusicology and electrical engineering, and all these interests united in his professional music life. The interest in improvisation and avant -garde expression will mark his journey in the coming decades. In the late 1970s, she came to a soft musical research - New York, where he was established on the lush avant -garde scene there. Since then, one of her leaders will remain, an unstoppable researcher who is continuously moving to the science of science, philosophy and music, constantly enriching his musical work with incentives in fields such as physics and mathematics. Sharp will not stay in abstract spheres, separated from rough social and political everyday life. Consistently radical roots of his music will remain a loyal engagement on the side of the weaker and the oppressed. Throughout this movement forward, Sharp, however, does not neglect the past and tradition. Irrational and rational, avant -garde and tradition - Sharp's music - music is duality, who understands that he is poor without each other, as the second is without the first dead ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Glasoviti avangardni glazbenik Elliott Sharp za svoju glazbu kaže da sadržava i ono uređeno i racionalno, i ono intuitivno i iracionalno. Ta dvostruka narav Sharpove goleme znatiželje bila je vidljiva od rane mladosti. Tijekom studija Sharpova se radoznalost grana u područja glazbene kompozicije, etnomuzikologije i elektrotehnike, a svi ti interesi sjedinili su se u njegovu profesionalnom muzičkom životu. Zanimanje za improvizaciju i avangardnu ekspresiju, obilježit će njegov put u idućim desetljećima. Potkraj sedamdesetih dolazi u meku glazbenog istraživanja - New York, gdje se etablira na tamošnjoj bujajućoj avangardnoj sceni. Otad pa do danas ostat će jedan od njezinih predvodnika, nezaustavljivi istraživač koji se neprekidno kreće razmeđem znanosti, filozofije i glazbe, konstantno obogaćujući svoj muzički rad poticajima iz područja poput fizike i matematike. Sharp pritom neće ostati u apstraktnim sferama, odvojenima od grube društvene i političke svakodnevice. Dosljedno radikalnim korijenima svoje glazbe, u njoj će ostati vjeran angažmanu na strani slabijih i potlačenih. U cijelom tom kretanju naprijed, Sharp, međutim, nipošto ne zapostavlja prošlost i tradiciju. Iracionalno i racionalno, avangarda i tradicija - Sharpova glazba - glazba je dvojnosti, koja razumije da je jedno bez drugoga siromašno, kao što je drugo bez prvoga mrtvo...

programme.title: The art of architecture / Umijeće arhitekture
programme.desc: The Art of Architecture - (E08, Educational Program, England, 2019) The series represents some of the most famous architects in the world. We will find out how art affects the great builders of our time, from Santiago Calatrave to Sir David Adjae. We will get acquainted with a variety of projects, from the Batters power plant, through the Vanda Museum in Dundee, Distiliya in Speyside, the National Museum of African American History and Culture in Washington, the remodeled Museum of Design in London, to Vessel, which is not a house, but a magnificent staircase that will soon become a new symbol of Manhattan. R .: Alastair Layzell Ul.: Alastair Layzell (Narrator) ... / The Art of Architecture - (E08, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2019) Serija predstavlja neke od najslavnijih arhitekata na svijetu. Saznat ćemo kako umjetnost utječe na velike graditelje našeg doba, od Santiaga Calatrave do Sir Davida Adjayea. Upoznat ćemo se s raznolikim projektima, od elektrane Battersea, preko muzeja VandA u Dundeeju, distilerije u Speysideu, Nacionalnog muzeja afroameričke povijesti i kulture u Washingtonu, preuređenog Muzeja dizajna u Londonu, do Vessela, koji nije kuća, nego veličanstveno stubište koje će uskoro postati novi simbol Manhattana. R.: Alastair Layzell Ul.: Alastair Layzell (Narrator)...

programme.title: Zagreb Classic / Zagreb Classic
programme.desc: ZAGREB CLASSIC - (Movie Class Music, Croatia, 2023) The Zagreb Classic 2023 Festival began on June 21 with the concert "Dream of Summer Night" at King Tomislav Square. The HRT Symphony Orchestra, young soprano Josipa Bilic, cellist Branimir Pustic and the ensemble of the Ballet of the Croatian National Theater in Zagreb, united under the leadership of Maestro Martin Yates to perform some of the most beautiful arias and orchestral and ballet points from Pera F. Mendelssohn - Bartholdy, P. I. Prokofiev, I. Stravinsky, L. Delibeus, E. Griega, G. Faurea and J. Strauss Ml. The versatile British musician, conductor Martin Yates, appreciated equally in his homeland and abroad as a composer and arranger, takes us through a lavish opera and an orchestral-dance story-from a clear summer night over a fairytale thorny thorny to fire dance dance! R .: Mirena Stijačić ... / Zagreb Classic - (film klas. glazbe, Hrvatska, 2023) Festival Zagreb Classic 2023. počeo je 21. lipnja koncertom "San ljetne noći" na Trgu kralja Tomislava. Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a , mlada sopranistica Josipa Bilić, violončelist Branimir Pustički i ansambl Baleta Hrvatskog narodnog kazališta u Zagrebu udružili su se pod vodstvom maestra Martina Yatesa kako bi izveli neke od najljepših arija te orkestralnih i baletnih točaka iz pera F. Mendelssohna - Bartholdyja, P. I. Čajkovskog, S. Prokofjeva, I. Stravinskog, L. Delibesa, E. Griega, G. Faurea te J. Straussa ml. Svestrani britanski glazbenik, dirigent Martin Yates, cijenjen podjednako u svojoj domovini i inozemstvu kao skladatelj i aranžer, vodi nas kroz raskošnu opernu te orkestralno-plesnu priču - od vedrog Sna ljetne noći preko bajkovite Trnoružice sve do vatrenog plesa Žar-ptice! R.: Mirena Stijačić...

programme.title: What is a classic? / Što je klasik?
programme.desc: What is a classic? - (Cult. Magazine, Croatia, 2025) What are Beckett's dramas about when they seem to talk about anything? Do they reveal more about ourselves than what is happening on stage? The questions that Irish Nobel laureate Samuel Beckett outlined in them are looking for answers today, as they did at the moment he wrote them. How do these answers seek students from the Academy of Dramatic Arts in Zagreb and why such irresponsible questions like their mentor, actor Drazen Sivak? Find out this in a new episode of the show what is a classic? ... / Što je klasik? - (kult. magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) O čemu govore Beckettove drame kad se čine da ne govore ni o čemu? Otkrivaju li time više o nama samima nego o onome što se događa na sceni? Pitanja koja je irski nobelovac Samuel Beckett u njima zacrtao traže odgovore i danas, kao i u trenutku kad ih je napisao. Kako te odgovore traže studenti s Akademije dramskih umjetnosti u Zagrebu i zašto takva neodgovoriva pitanja voli njihov mentor, glumac Dražen Šivak? Doznajte to u novoj epizodi emisije Što je klasik?...

programme.title: Films B.Tavnerier: Let the celebration began / Filmovi B.Tavneriera: Neka slavlje počne
programme.desc: Que La Feta Commence ... - (Drama, France, 1975) The historical drama about life in the court in the period before the French Revolution, better known as the age of regentism. The year is 1719, the French King Louis XIV. He died four years ago, and Filip Orlean (P. Noiret) is a regent for five -year -old Louis XV. He is a liberal and a liberal, he even managed to calm the peasant rebellions. For his assistant, he took Cardinal Guillaume Dubois (J. Rochefort), also a libertin ... R .: Bertrand Tavernier Ul.: Philippe Noire (Philippe Dorleans), Jean Rochefort (father Dubois), Jean-Pierre Marielle (Marquis de Pontcallec), Christine Pascal (Emilie), Adam (Le Marechal de Villeroi) ... / Que la fete commence ... - (drama, Francuska, 1975) Povijesna drama o životu na dvoru u razdoblju prije Francuske revolucije, poznatije kao doba regentstva. Godina je 1719., francuski kralj Luj XIV. umro je prije četiri godine, a Filip Orleanski (P. Noiret) regent je za petogodišnjeg Luja XV. On je liberal i libertinac, čak je uspio smiriti seljačke bune. Za svog pomoćnika uzeo je kardinala Guillaumea Duboisa (J. Rochefort), također libertinca... R.: Bertrand Tavernier Ul.: Philippe Noiret (Philippe dOrleans), Jean Rochefort (otac Dubois), Jean-Pierre Marielle (markiz de Pontcallec), Christine Pascal (Emilie), Alfred Adam (Le marechal de Villeroi)...

programme.title: Generation y / Generacija Y
programme.desc: Generation Y - (S01, Doc. Series, Croatia, 2010) The foundation of a healthy society says it is a family. But not every family is complete. In fact, what if it does not consist of all members who form a family? Through the prism of a mother who adopted a child, through a girl who grew up with her grandmother, through a family with many brothers and sisters in the episode "Children and Parents" from the Generation Y series, we will find out what it looks like to grow up some of the family members. What is parenting, which is most looking forward to raising children, how to manage in a single mother's situation ... Their common message is: everything rests on love! R .: Petar Oreskovic ... / Generacija Y - (S01, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2010) Temelj zdravog društva kažu da je obitelj. Ali nije svaka obitelj cjelovita. Zapravo, što ako se ne sastoji od svih članova koji tvore obitelj? Kroz prizmu majke koja je usvojila dijete, kroz djevojku koja je odrasla uz baku, kroz obitelj s mnogo braće i sestara u epizodi "Djeca i roditelji" iz serije Generacije Y saznat ćemo kako izgleda odrastanje nekih od članova obitelji. Što je roditeljstvo, što najviše veseli u odgajanju djece, kako se snaći u situaciji samohrane majke... Njihova zajednička poruka je: sve počiva na ljubavi! R.: Petar Orešković...

programme.title: Garage / Garaža
programme.desc: Garage - (music. Show, Croatia, 2012) Luka Belani is a young, extremely talented singer -songwriter from Križevci with a Zagreb address. With his albums B-Side of My Mind (2009) and Changin Chapters (2011) he attracted attention to both criticism and audiences. The B-Side of My Mind called several eminent critics a debut-album of the year, and the radio single Guarded by Angels finished fifth in the annual list of the most performed domestic songs on one of Zagreb's listened to Zagreb's radio. Chargin Chapters achieved an even greater success that resulted in significant radio broadcasting, great media attention, excellent reviews in printed and internet media and performing at the 2011 INmusic Festival on the main stage. The album was listed in the Top5 home albums 2011 on the annual list of a well -known portal involving 32 music editors and journalists. The experience has more than 300 appearances, solo and with a band. In addition to performances in Croatia, this includes performances in London, Hungary, Serbia and three tour in Germany, of which in April 2012, she was a mini-European including Vienna and Amsterdam ... / Garaža - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2012) Luka Belani je mladi, izuzetno talentirani kantautor iz Križevaca sa zagrebačkom adresom. Svojim albumima B-Side Of My Mind (2009.) te Changin Chapters (2011.) privukao je pažnju i kritike i publike. B-Side Of My Mind nekoliko je eminentnih kritičara nazivalo debi-albumom godine, a radijski singl Guarded By Angels završio je na petom mjestu godišnje liste najizvođenijih domaćih pjesama na jednom od slušanijih zagrebačkih radija. Changin Chapters je postigao još veći uspjeh koji je rezultirao znatnijim radijskim emitiranjem, velikom medijskom pažnjom, odličnim recenzijama u tiskanim i internetskim medijima te nastupom na INmusic festivalu 2011. na glavnoj pozornici. Album je uvršten u Top5 domaćih albuma 2011. po godišnjoj listi jednoga poznatog portala u kojoj je sudjelovalo 32 glazbenih urednika i novinara. Iskustvom broji više od 300 nastupa, solo i s bendom. Uz nastupe u Hrvatskoj, to uključuje i nastupe u Londonu, Mađarskoj, Srbiji te tri turneje u Njemačkoj, od kojih je ona u travnju 2012. bila i mini-europska uključujući Beč i Amsterdam...

programme.title: Smrt / Smrt
programme.desc: La Commare Secca - (Crimea Film, Italy, 1962) near Tiber in the park was found a murdered prostitute. Police have brought people who were in the park during the night, examining them, and they explain why they were there and what they did. One of them is the killer ... R .: Bernardo Bertolucci Ul.: Marisa Solinas (Bruna), Alfredo Leggi (Bostelli), Francesco Rui (Canticchia), Romano Labate (Pipito), Lorenza Benedetti (Milly) ... / La commare secca - (krim. film, Italija, 1962) U blizini Tibera u parku je nađena ubijena prostitutka. Policija je privela ljude koji su tijekom noći bili u parku, ispituju ih, a oni objašnjavaju zašto su bili tamo i što su radili. Jedan od njih je ubojica... R.: Bernardo Bertolucci Ul.: Marisa Solinas (Bruna), Alfredo Leggi (Bostelli), Francesco Ruiu (Canticchia), Romano Labate (Pipito), Lorenza Benedetti (Milly)...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) Famous avant -garde musician Elliott Sharp tells of his music that he contains both decorated and rational, both intuitive and irrational. That double nature of Sharp's huge curiosity was visible from an early age. During the study of Sharp's, the curiosity of the branches in the fields of music composition, ethnomusicology and electrical engineering, and all these interests united in his professional music life. The interest in improvisation and avant -garde expression will mark his journey in the coming decades. In the late 1970s, she came to a soft musical research - New York, where he was established on the lush avant -garde scene there. Since then, one of her leaders will remain, an unstoppable researcher who is continuously moving to the science of science, philosophy and music, constantly enriching his musical work with incentives in fields such as physics and mathematics. Sharp will not stay in abstract spheres, separated from rough social and political everyday life. Consistently radical roots of his music will remain a loyal engagement on the side of the weaker and the oppressed. Throughout this movement forward, Sharp, however, does not neglect the past and tradition. Irrational and rational, avant -garde and tradition - Sharp's music - music is duality, who understands that he is poor without each other, as the second is without the first dead ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Glasoviti avangardni glazbenik Elliott Sharp za svoju glazbu kaže da sadržava i ono uređeno i racionalno, i ono intuitivno i iracionalno. Ta dvostruka narav Sharpove goleme znatiželje bila je vidljiva od rane mladosti. Tijekom studija Sharpova se radoznalost grana u područja glazbene kompozicije, etnomuzikologije i elektrotehnike, a svi ti interesi sjedinili su se u njegovu profesionalnom muzičkom životu. Zanimanje za improvizaciju i avangardnu ekspresiju, obilježit će njegov put u idućim desetljećima. Potkraj sedamdesetih dolazi u meku glazbenog istraživanja - New York, gdje se etablira na tamošnjoj bujajućoj avangardnoj sceni. Otad pa do danas ostat će jedan od njezinih predvodnika, nezaustavljivi istraživač koji se neprekidno kreće razmeđem znanosti, filozofije i glazbe, konstantno obogaćujući svoj muzički rad poticajima iz područja poput fizike i matematike. Sharp pritom neće ostati u apstraktnim sferama, odvojenima od grube društvene i političke svakodnevice. Dosljedno radikalnim korijenima svoje glazbe, u njoj će ostati vjeran angažmanu na strani slabijih i potlačenih. U cijelom tom kretanju naprijed, Sharp, međutim, nipošto ne zapostavlja prošlost i tradiciju. Iracionalno i racionalno, avangarda i tradicija - Sharpova glazba - glazba je dvojnosti, koja razumije da je jedno bez drugoga siromašno, kao što je drugo bez prvoga mrtvo...

Trojica muškaraca započinju razgovor. Tri dana ranije jedan od njih, drvosječa, krenuo je u šumu skupljati drva i putem naišao na leš ubijenog muškarca. Drvosječa započne priču o svome svjedočenju na sudu, opisujući potom i svjedočenja ostalih ljudi. Prvo važno svjedočanstvo daje zloglasni lopov Tajomaru (T. Mifune), osumnjičen da je ubio nesretnog muškarca Takehira (M. Mori) i ukrao njegovu imovinu. Okrutni Tajomaru iznosi svoje svjedočanstvo, govoreći kako nije kanio počiniti ubojstvo, već silovati muškarčevu ženu Masako (M. Kyo). Prema njegovim riječima, nakon što je to učinio, žena je zbog ponosa tražila da jedan od njih umre, te je Tajomaru u dvoboju časno ubio Takehira. Ženino svjedočanstvo posve je drugačije, kao i ostala koja će uslijediti, a upitna je i drvosječina priča... R.: Akira Kurosawa Ul.: Toshirô Mifune (Tajomaru), Machiko Kyô (Masako, supruga), Masayuki Mori (Takehiro, suprug), Takashi Shimura (drvosjeća), Minoru Chiaki (budistički svečenik)...

programme.title: Out of format / Izvan formata
programme.desc: Out of format - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2023) for Marija Kulusic, the starting point in the paper is an uncompromising selection of materials and preserving his own legacy and tradition of clothing. It works by hand, the fabrics color with natural colors, and also uses recycled materials. Her vintage fabrics are also interesting, so she used the materials produced on a loom about 70 years ago. The fashion duo Tomislav Kliskinic and Marko Sabaric at the "NEVER HAVE PARIS" have presented skillfully tailored suits, dresses with romantic hearts, coats made of materials that were in the fundus of Brenda. In doing so, Klisab sent a clear message - sustainability in fashion is our choice. In the studio, we talk to designers Marija Kulušić and Klisabovci Tomislav Kliskinic and Marko Sabaric. R.: Vesna Lukovic Žarno ... / Izvan formata - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2023) Za Mariju Kulušić polazište u radu su beskompromisan odabir materijala te očuvanje vlastitog naslijeđa i tradicije izrade odjeće. Ona radi ručno, tkanine boji prirodnim bojilima, a upotrebljava i reciklirane materijale. Zanimljive su joj i vintage tkanine, pa je tako rabila materijale proizvedene na tkalačkom stanu prije 70-ak godina. Modni dvojac Tomislav Kliškinić i Marko Šabarić na reviji "Nikada nećemo imati Pariz" predstavili su vješto krojena odijela, haljine s romantičnim srcima, kapute izrađene od materijala koji su bili u fundusu brenda. Time je Klisab poslao jasnu poruku - održivost u modi naš je izbor. U studiju razgovaramo s dizajnerima Marijom Kulušić i klisabovcima Tomislavom Kliškinićem i Markom Šabarićem. R.: Vesna Luković Žarn...

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2022) Forty authors from Croatia and abroad were hanging out at the Zagreb Book Festival 2022. The title theme was "Apocalypse Today: or about the relationship between nature and society", and we spoke with Rachid Lamrabet, the Belgian author of Moroccan origin, whose novel " The protagonist is a young Moroccan who, along with young men from other French colonies, fought on the French side during the First World War. After the excursion to the history of France and Morocco, we return to the present of Croatia and Bosnia. After the collection of "Fafarikul", Đurđica Čilić wrote "The New End" we will talk about in our studio ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2022) Četrdesetak autora iz Hrvatske i inozemstva družilo se na Zagreb Book Festivalu 2022. Naslovna tema bila je "Apokalipsa danas: ili o odnosu prirode i društva", a mi smo razgovarali s Rachidom Lamrabet, belgijskom autoricom marokanskog podrijetla, čiji smo roman "Reci to nekome" pročitali u prijevodu Romane Perečinec. Protagonist je mladi Marokanac koji se, zajedno s mladićima iz drugih francuskih kolonija, tijekom Prvog svjetskog rata borio na francuskoj strani. Nakon izleta u povijest Francuske i Maroka vraćamo se u sadašnjost Hrvatske i Bosne. Nakon zbirke priča "Fafarikul" Đurđica Čilić napisala je "Novi kraj" o kojem ćemo razgovarati u našem studiju...

programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: The world of classics - (music. Show, Croatia, 2024) Kresimir Stranac is a true example of Basbariton - a bass with heights and baritone with depths, a voice that covers most of the deep lies of classic singing repertoire. Although he started his career as a member of the prestigious Ciri -opera, he quit to be free and achieve a balance between concert and opera performances. As he thinks of his music career, he reveals in a conversation recorded on the eve of his concert in the Zagreb Soloist season exactly on Mozartov 268 birthday, January 27, 2024 in the Lisinski Hall. For the program, he selected the rarely performed Mozarot concert aria for bass, as well as the famous opera fragments - Aria Leporella, and don Giovanni from the opera "Don Giovanni" written on Libreta Lorenza da Ponte. Members of the Zagreb Soloists also speak about the cooperation on the project for the show "The World of the Classic": President of the Administrative Council of the Ensemble, violinist Krunoslav Maric, and the concert master of the Sreten Krstic ensemble, who handled Mozart's orchestral syllable for the twelve string ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Krešimir Stražanac pravi je primjer basbaritona - basa s visinama i baritona s dubinama, glasa koji pokriva najveći dio dubokih laga klasičnog pjevačkog repertoara. Premda je karijeru počeo kao član prestižne Ciriške opere, dao je otkaz kako bi bio slobodan i postigao ravnotežu između koncertnih i opernih nastupa. Kako promišlja svoju glazbenu karijeru, otkriva u razgovoru snimljenom uoči njegova koncerta u sezoni Zagrebačkih solista upriličenom točno na Mozartov 268. rođendan, 27. siječnja 2024. u Maloj dvorani Lisinski. Za program je odabrao rijetko izvođene Mozarotove koncertantne arije za bas, ali i poznate operne ulomke - ariju Leporella, te Don Giovannija iz opere "Don Giovanni" pisane na libreto Lorenza da Pontea. O suradnji na tom projektu za emisiju "Svijet klasike" govore i članovi Zagrebačkih solista: predsjednik upravnog vijeća ansambla, violinist Krunoslav Marić, te koncertni majstor ansambla Sreten Krstić, koji je Mozartov orkestralni slog obradio za dvanaestoro gudača...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) The name of Richard Galliana is so strongly related to the accordion in contemporary jazz that they are almost synonymous with each other. This instrument Galliano, namely, marked not only as a unique virtuoso, but also as a genre driver who deeply influenced the modern intersection of jazz with two great music traditions - Argentine tango and French Musette. Galliano connects all these influences to a distinctive southern compound that bursts with musical expressiveness and freedom, regardless of whether it is vibrant tango interpretations or subtle ballads. The implementing thread that connects everything is an improvisator spirit of jazz, which is unwaveringly playful in Galliana and forces him to constantly search for a new performance and collaborations such as his New York Tango Triah, with which he appeared on the Opatija Liburnia Jazz Festival in early July. On that occasion, two virtuosos of unobtrusiveness, the double bass player Diego Imbert and guitarist Jean-Marie Ecay, performed with Gallian, in which the famous accordionist found ideal interviewees for his Mediterranean, a colored vision of music ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Ime Richarda Galliana toliko je snažno povezano s harmonikom u suvremenom jazzu da su jedno s drugim gotovo sinonimi. Taj je instrument Galliano, naime, obilježio ne samo kao jedinstven virtuoz nego i kao žanrovski pokretač koji je duboko utjecao na moderno prepletanje jazza s dvjema velikim muzičkim tradicijama - argentinskim tangom i francuskim musetteom. Sve te utjecaje Galliano povezuje u prepoznatljivo južni spoj koji pršti glazbenom ekspresivnošću i slobodom, neovisno o tome je li riječ o živahnim interpretacijama tanga ili o suptilnim baladama. Provodna nit koja sve povezuje improvizatorski je duh jazza, koji je u Galliana nepokolebljivo zaigran i tjera ga na konstantno traženje novog u izvedbama i suradnjama poput njegova New York Tango Trija, s kojim je gostovao na opatijskom Liburnia Jazz Festivalu početkom srpnja. Tom su prigodom uz Galliana nastupala dva virtuoza nenametljivosti, kontrabasist Diego Imbert i gitarist Jean-Marie Ecay, u kojima je slavni harmonikaš pronašao idealne sugovornike za svoje Mediteranom obojeno viđenje glazbe...

programme.title: The art of architecture / Umijeće arhitekture
programme.desc: The Art of Architecture - (E09, Educational Program, England, 2019) The series represents some of the most famous architects in the world. We will find out how art affects the great builders of our time, from Santiago Calatrave to Sir David Adjae. We will get acquainted with a variety of projects, from the Batters power plant, through the Vanda Museum in Dundee, Distiliya in Speyside, the National Museum of African American History and Culture in Washington, the remodeled Museum of Design in London, to Vessel, which is not a house, but a magnificent staircase that will soon become a new symbol of Manhattan. R .: Alastair Layzell Ul.: Alastair Layzell (Narrator) ... / The Art of Architecture - (E09, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2019) Serija predstavlja neke od najslavnijih arhitekata na svijetu. Saznat ćemo kako umjetnost utječe na velike graditelje našeg doba, od Santiaga Calatrave do Sir Davida Adjayea. Upoznat ćemo se s raznolikim projektima, od elektrane Battersea, preko muzeja VandA u Dundeeju, distilerije u Speysideu, Nacionalnog muzeja afroameričke povijesti i kulture u Washingtonu, preuređenog Muzeja dizajna u Londonu, do Vessela, koji nije kuća, nego veličanstveno stubište koje će uskoro postati novi simbol Manhattana. R.: Alastair Layzell Ul.: Alastair Layzell (Narrator)...

programme.title: The art of architecture / Umijeće arhitekture
programme.desc: The Art of Architecture - (E10, Educational Program, England, 2019) The Hall at the London Palace of Alexandra, which has been waiting for the audience for eighty years, was restored by architect Matt Somerville. The team from his bureau feilden Clegg Bradley decided to keep most of what they found - including the damage that arose while the BBC served as a storage for props. Result? Victorian theater adapted to today's needs, along with traces of stopped decay. R .: Alastair Layzell Ul.: Alastair Layzell (Narrator) ... / The Art of Architecture - (E10, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2019) Dvoranu u londonskoj palači Alexandra, koja je osamdeset godina čekala publiku, obnovio je arhitekt Matt Somerville. Ekipa iz njegova biroa Feilden Clegg Bradley odlučila je zadržati većinu onoga što su pronašli - uključujući i štetu koja je nastala dok je BBC-ju služila kao spremište za rekvizite. Rezultat? Viktorijansko kazalište prilagođeno današnjim potrebama, zajedno s tragovima zaustavljenog propadanja. R.: Alastair Layzell Ul.: Alastair Layzell (Narrator)...

programme.title: Soba / Soba
programme.desc: Room - (Drama, Canada, 2015) in Akron in Ohi, 24 -year -old Joy Newsome (B. Larson) and her five -year -old son Jack live in a miserable shed called "Room". They share a bed, toilet, tub, TV and kitchen. The only window they have is the roof. Prisoners are a man called old Nick (S. Bridgers). He is Jack's biological father who abducted Joy seven years ago. It regularly rapes it while Jack sleeps in the closet. Joy is trying to stay optimistic about his son, but suffers from malnutrition and depression. Allows Jack to believe that they are real "room" and what is in it, and that the rest of the world exists only on television ... R.: Lenny Abrahamson Ul .: Brie Larson (Ma), Jacob Tremblay (Jack), Joan Allen (Nancy), Sean Bridgers (Old Nick), William H. Macy (Robert) ... / Room - (drama, Kanada, 2015) U Akronu u Ohiju 24-godišnja Joy Newsome (B. Larson) i njezin petogodišnji sin Jack žive u bijednoj šupi koju zovu "soba". Dijele krevet, WC, kadu, televizor i kuhinjicu. Jedini prozor koji imaju je krovni. Zatočenici su čovjeka kojeg zovu stari Nick (S. Bridgers). On je Jackov biološki otac koji je prije sedam godina oteo Joy. Redovito je siluje dok Jack spava u ormaru. Joy pokušava ostati optimistična zbog sina, ali pati od pothranjenosti i depresije. Dopušta Jacku da vjeruje kako su stvarni samo "soba" i ono što se nalazi u njoj, a da ostatak svijeta postoji samo na televiziji... R.: Lenny Abrahamson Ul.: Brie Larson (Ma), Jacob Tremblay (Jack), Joan Allen (Nancy), Sean Bridgers (Old Nick), William H. Macy (Robert)...

programme.title: Italian / Italiana
programme.desc: Italiana - (e02, nature. Film, Italy) In the Cinque Terre National Park, there is a story about the last stubborn ligurian farmers who have decided to learn to make terraceous gardens with drywalls. The result is in front of your eyes: a miracle in the interspace between the mountains and the sea. "Mountaineering Museum" Reinhold Messner was a full hit. His vision merged with the genius of the famous architects of Zahe Hadid, which enabled museum spaces to open in the mountains of South Tyrol. It shows another museum, "Lumen". Just a white and porous country like that in Altamura in the sunny Apulia could give bread and cheese in numerous shades of white. We re-discover timeless flavors and colors thanks to the new generation of cosmopolitan craftsmen. Palatin chapel in Palermo is a wonder that needs to be seen at least once in life. If you haven't done so yet, discover the chapel in the story of an internationally known art historian. Material and its end Can the material known all over the world have a soul that is so rooted in the end where it originated? The entrepreneurial genius of the family from Piedmont speaks Anna Zegna, the president of the foundation and this oasis in the province of Biella ... / Italiana - (E02, prirod. film, Italija) U Nacionalnom parku Cinque Terre postoji priča o petorici zadnjih tvrdoglavih ligurskih zemljoradnika koji su mlade doseljenike odlučili naučiti praviti terasaste vrtove sa suhozidima. Rezultat je pred vašim očima: čudo u međuprostoru između planine i mora. "Muzej planinarenja" Reinholda Messnera bio je pun pogodak. Njegova se vizija spojila s genijem slavne arhitektice Zahe Hadid koja je omogućila da se muzejski prostori otvore u planinama Južnog Tirola. To pokazuje još jedan muzej, "Lumen". Samo bijela i porozna zemlja poput one u Altamuri u sunčanoj Apuliji mogla je dati kruh i sir u mnogobrojnim nijansama bijele boje. Ponovno otkrivamo bezvremenske okuse i boje zahvaljujući novoj generaciji kozmopolitskih obrtnika. Palatinska kapela u Palermu čudo je koje treba vidjeti barem jedanput u životu. Ako to još niste učinili, kapelu otkrijte u priči međunarodno poznatog povjesničara umjetnosti. Materijal i njegov kraj Može li materijal poznat u cijelom svijetu imati dušu koja je toliko ukorijenjena u kraj u kojem je nastao? O poduzetničkom geniju obitelji iz Pijemonta govori Anna Zegna, predsjednica Zaklade i ove oaze u pokrajini Biella...

programme.desc: A drama inspired by the stories of life, every story is presented in ten episodes that discuss issues of concern to society in general and women's issues in particular, and revolves in several tales, including (House of Ezz), (my story with time) and (taste of the world). / دراما مستوحاة من قصص الحياة، كل قصة تقدم في عشر حلقات تناقش قضايا تهم المجتمع بصفة عامة وقضايا المرأة بصفة خاصة، وتدور في عدة حكايات منها (بيت العز) و(حكايتي مع الزمان) و(طعم الدنيا).

programme.title: Customer / العميل
programme.desc: The story of the series revolves around the brothers Amir and Medal who are separated by destiny from a young age, Amir grows up to become a police officer, but he joins a gang as part of a secret operation. While his brother Wissam, who was kidnapped when he was a child, grows up to become part of the same gang. programme.title: Secret Part 2: Challenge / سر ج2: التحدي
programme.desc: The battle of Amer Badran begins after leaving the imprisonment to confront the investigator Jad again, and to work with the Don in the trading of the prohibitions for the escalation of events. / تبدأ معركة عامر بدران بعد خروجه من الحبس لمواجهة المحقق جاد من جديد، والعمل مع الدون في تجارة الممنوعات لتتصاعد الأحداث.

programme.title: Except I am 2 / إلا أنا ج2

programme.title: Inheritance C2 / الميراث ج2
programme.desc: In this part, the events develop after the death of Juwairiya, as Ibrahim doubts and witnessed her death, and she marries Sahar from Talal without the knowledge of his family, and the fire between Dima and Majid caught her doubt about the existence of a relationship between him and Asia. / في هذا الجزء تتطور الأحداث بعد وفاة جويرية، حيث يشك إبراهيم وشهد في وفاتها المدبرة، وتتزوج سحر من طلال دون علم أهله، وتشتعل النيران بين ديما وماجد لشكها في وجود علاقة بينه وبين آسيا.

programme.title: Bahar / Bahar
programme.desc: The life of the housewife (Bahar), full of disappointments, becomes a new meaning when she returns from death, and it is decided to complete her dream that she abandoned, and to confront the society that he considered dead. / تصبح حياة ربة المنزل (بهار) المليئة بخيبات الأمل ذات معنى جديد حين تعود من الموت، وتُقرر استكمال حلمها الذي تخلت عنه، ومواجهة المجتمع الذي اعتبرها ميتة.

programme.title: My Name Is Farah S2 / My Name Is Farah S2
programme.desc: After a long hunt, (Benham) finally finds (Farah), and at the same time, (Taher) is released and faces many challenges, from an attempt to kill to attempts to discourage him from his plan for revenge. / بعد مطاردة طويلة، يعثر (بنهام) أخيرًا على (فرح)، وفي الوقت نفسه، يتم إطلاق سراح (طاهر) ويواجه العديد من التحديات، من محاولة قتل إلى محاولات إثنائه عن خطته للانتقام.

programme.title: Family Secrets / Family Secrets

Without their knowledge, the brothers work together without knowing their reality, and their fate is intertwined in an exciting framework full of suspense. / تدور قصة المسلسل حول الأخوين أمير ووسام الذين يفرقهما القدر منذ الصغر، يكبر أمير ليصبح ضابط شرطة، لكنه ينضم لعصابة كجزء من عملية سرية. بينما أخوه وسام، الذي اختطف عندما كان طفلاً، يكبر ليصبح جزءً من نفس العصابة. بدون علمهما، يعمل الأخوان معًا دون معرفة حقيقتهما، ويتشابك مصيرهما في إطار مثير مليء بالتشويق.

programme.title: Canilo .Vs Croford Fight Week / كانيلو .Vs كروفورد فايت ويك
Full / كامل العدد
programme.desc: When Ahmed, the plastic surgeon, and Layla, who has a cosmetic project, quickly meets each other, but their various family circumstances standing in an obstacle to the relationship, but they decide to marry and challenge the circumstances. / عندما يتقابل أحمد طبيب التجميل، وليلى صاحبة مشروع مستحضرات التجميل سرعان ما يقعا في غرام بعضهما البعض، ولكن ظروفهما العائلية المختلفة تقف سببا عائقا أمام العلاقة، ولكنهما يقررا الزواج وتحدي الظروف.
